positions.assessment: Exactly 3 DARK monsters are in the GY (Kris, Chinook, Vata), so Dark Armed Dragon is live only now. Any Synchro first sends Sudri/Sharnga (DARK) to the GY and shuts DAD off. DAD first loses nothing: the Boreastorm → Full Armor Master → Assault Dragon line is still available afterwards. The cost is one extra Maxx C draw for the opponent.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: The Boreastorm → Full Armor Master → Assault Dragon line is strong, but starting it makes the GY 4+ DARK and throws away Dark Armed Dragon's free extra body and removal.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: Summoning DAD while the GY has exactly 3 DARK costs nothing, and the Synchro line can follow. It adds a removal-capable 2800 body to the board.

grades.label: C
grades.reason: It makes Full Armor Master but sends Sharnga to the GY, which turns off DAD. It also skips Assault Dragon and leaves a weaker board.

positions.assessment: The opponent has no monsters and 5200 LP. Three attackers deal 9000 directly, so this is lethal. Which one attacks first barely matters, since the opponent has only 3 unknown cards.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: Attacking with Full Armor Master first is lethal and it is unaffected by other cards' effects, so it is the safest opener.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: Assault Dragon swinging first is equally lethal. All three attacks together exceed 5200, so the order is immaterial.

positions.assessment: The turn-1 board is Chinook and BWD, and the hand is Ahrima, Enemy Controller and Vata. Discarding Ahrima for a free Lair of Darkness is card advantage, and Enemy Controller can still be Set afterwards. Keeping Ahrima for a later Simoon search is possible but awkward, because Simoon needs an empty board. Both lines are reasonable.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: Setting Enemy Controller is right, but holding Ahrima for a Normal Summon plus Tribute to find Simoon is slow and clashes with Simoon's empty-board requirement.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: It converts a mediocre body into a free Lair of Darkness search, then Sets Enemy Controller, so it gets both.
